why: One case per bug this comparison has already caught, named after the bug. Each of these shipped, or nearly shipped, and none of them was found by reading code or by a Go unit test — they were found by asking both tiers the same question and looking at the bytes. A failure here is a bug coming back, and the label says which one.

elsewhere.why: Two of the divergences the comparison found are not in this tier at all: they were found between the Python and Go MCP servers, which speak JSON-RPC over stdio rather than HTTP and have no route to ask. They are pinned where they live, and are listed here so the record of what this comparison has caught stays in one place.
elsewhere.timelimit_field_order_unit_test: soloclef_celery/celery/message_test.go, "timelimit is not [hard, soft]" — the envelope comparison below is the same bug asked end to end
elsewhere.unmatched_paths: A path or method no ported route answers is not compared: the proxy's matchers are anchored regexes that match exactly the routes in parity/routes.json, so such a request never reaches the Go tier, and its 404 there is text/plain where Starlette's is JSON. custom/docs/go-api-tier.md records that as an open question with a known answer (forward it), and a suite that compared it would fail on a request neither tier is asked.
